summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a Form 6-K reporting European Commission approval of Trixeo Aerosphere (budesonide/glycopyrronium/formoterol, 320/28.8/10µg) as maintenance asthma therapy for patients 12 and older uncontrolled on medium-dose ICS/LABA, the first single-inhaler triple combination approved in the EU for asthma, following a positive CHMP opinion. Approval rested on KALOS and LOGOS Phase III trials showing significant lung-function improvement and reduced severe exacerbation rates, including in patients with no prior-year exacerbations. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply; this is a routine regulatory milestone disclosure, not a special situation. Watch commercial uptake and pending China review.
